name: Charnel Colossus — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Charnel Colossus from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Charnel Colossus" but are not part of the Charnel Colossus entry, which is unchanged.

SQ amalgamated metapsion, corporate will

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Amalgamated Metapsion (Su)

A charnel colossus is composed of dozens if not hundreds of psionic creatures whose bodies have fused to form an incredibly powerful entity at a great cost. The charnel colossus manifests as a 16th-level wilder, save that it can learn powers from any power list and may exchange any one power it knows for another power of equal level as a full-round action. The charnel colossus is considered to have an infinite number of power points and psionic foci to expend as it wishes, but no effect that the charnel colossus manifests lasts longer than a number of rounds equal to the charnel colossus’ Charisma modifier (usually 7).

Corporate Will (Su)

ABOUT

When a large collection of gifted minds seeks to merge themselves together in the pursuit of understanding or immortality, the ensuing bombardment of conflicting thoughts and sensations can birth an undead of tremendous power and fanatical appetite. The hivemind of a charnel colossus always believes that it is one mind away from achieving perfect stability and so gluts itself on other intelligent beings in a hunt for completion. In Aurin, a charnel colossus assembled during the Makers’ War is said to still stalk the depths of Moloss.
